mappings.scope: Integration of connected devices on one substrate; distinct pattern removal, dopant introduction, planarity and test mechanisms require their own process qualification.
General die protection and electrical/thermal interface design; specific joining and vertical-interconnect processes are distinct physical mechanisms.
Architectural organization and externally specified execution; pipelining, scheduling and lane organization are distinct implementation techniques.
Transaction consistency and recovery contract; logging and version visibility are distinct implementation choices, not both universal prerequisites.
General fault detection and redundancy; persistent job resumption and replica ownership transfer address different recovery states.
Learning objective and model fitting; evaluation separation, calibration and model compression each change a distinct evidence or resource mechanism.
